questions.q: What are the three steps of RAG at question time?
options: Train, validate, deploy
Tokenize, embed, decode
Cluster, label, report
Retrieve relevant chunks, augment the prompt with them, generate the answer
questions.explain: RAG searches your data, adds the results to the prompt as context, and lets the LLM answer from it.

questions.q: Why is RAG often preferred to retraining a model to teach it changing company facts?
options: Retraining is impossible for any model
You can update knowledge by re-indexing documents, and answers can cite sources
RAG removes the need for any evaluation
RAG guarantees the model never hallucinates
questions.explain: Re-indexing is cheaper and faster than retraining, and retrieved sources can be shown. RAG reduces, but does not eliminate, hallucination.

questions.q: In the demo, the question "Can I pay with bitcoin?" matched nothing above the minimum score. What did build_prompt do?
options: Returned None, so the application can say it doesn't know or hand off, instead of letting the model guess
Sent the question to the LLM with an empty context
Lowered the threshold until something matched
Returned the first chunk in the knowledge base
questions.explain: Handling the no-relevant-context case explicitly is a key RAG habit.

questions.q: Which instruction in the prompt template helps keep answers grounded?
options: Write as creatively as possible
Ignore the context if you know better
Answer in as many words as you can
Answer using only the context below, and say you don't know if the answer is not there
questions.explain: Telling the model to answer only from the provided context and to admit when it is missing reduces ungrounded answers.

questions.q: Which is a listed RAG failure mode, paired with a sensible response?
options: Retrieval misses the right chunk; measure precision@k and recall@k on labeled questions
The index is too accurate; delete it
Chunks are always perfect; skip testing chunk sizes
Retrieved text can never contain instructions; trust it fully
questions.explain: Retrieval quality should be measured separately from answer quality. Also treat retrieved text as data because it can contain injected instructions.
